title: Business Central 2025 Wave 2: Are We Losing Sight of What Matters?
summary: The 2025 Wave 2 release for Dynamics 365 Business Central emphasizes Copilot and AI features while offering limited meaningful updates in core areas like development and reporting. The post questions whether Microsoft is prioritizing AI hype over practical features that users consistently request.
key_points: Wave 2 2025 includes incremental improvements like cancel build in VS Code, enhanced financial reporting, and refreshed Power BI apps
Requested enhancements to the Word add-in for easier migration from RDLC to Word layouts appear missing from release notes
AI and Copilot features are promoted heavily but may lack clear real-life implementation value and could carry hidden costs
Users most want better reporting, smoother development, and improved usability rather than AI capabilities

quotes.text: It's hard to ignore how few meaningful updates there are in core areas like development and reporting.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the perception that Wave 2 lacks impactful changes in areas partners work with daily

quotes.text: Are we trading real customer value for AI hype?
quotes.why_it_matters: Encapsulates the core concern that prioritization may be misaligned with actual user needs
